name: WAN Core
description: Protocol-neutral WAN adapter. It normalizes WAN driver session state, creates a local veth/vtap handoff, and publishes the interfaces that should be connected to the fvtap/forward core pipeline.

virtual_interfaces.description: Logical WAN endpoint backed by a protocol driver and a vtap handoff.

resources.description: WAN adapter defaults such as local/vtap interface names, MTU, addresses, and route policy.
Normalized WAN driver session state. Any protocol driver can publish this shape.
Last applied WAN adapter state and forward_core handoff details.

actions.description: Apply a normalized WAN session from payload or the sessions resource.
Delete the configured local handoff veth pair and mark the WAN adapter down.
